name: Simple_Stipple
observations: Desktop app for drafting, tracing, and generating pattern fills for laser/vector workflows
Version 0.3.4, Python 3.10+, PySide6 Qt
Package name: simple-stipple, installed from src/simple_stipple
Entry point: simple_stipple.app.launcher:main, also python -m simple_stipple
CLI script: simple-stipple
Dependencies: PySide6, ezdxf, shapely, Pillow, opencv-python-headless, scipy, numba, pyclipper, pydantic
Optional deps: dev (pytest, ruff, mypy, pyright, pytest-qt, hypothesis), build (pyinstaller), telemetry (sentry-sdk), cad (python-solvespace)
Build: setuptools, wheel packaging with DXF tiles, QSS styles, SVG icons
Release: scripts/release.sh tags trigger GitHub Actions for Windows EXE + macOS DMG
Self-updates on Windows: SHA-256 verified, rollback-safe, detached updater process

name: Architecture
observations: Capability-first modular monolith with src-layout
Dependency direction: platform/engine -> document -> (canvas, features) -> app
app is the composition root, may import every subsystem
Feature packages never import each other's internals; shared behavior goes in features.base
Engine and document contain no Qt dependencies
Platform imports no product, UI, document, or engine subsystem
Canvas imports no app or product feature
Verification: tests/test_dependency_boundaries.py enforces rules
No common/misc/helpers/utils directories — promote code only after 2+ consumers
Legacy packages (backend, core, ui.pages, ui.canvas) removed, imports updated to canonical homes
